verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an inference and fine-tuning platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, zero-retention options, or deletion of prompts, uploaded files or fine-tuning data. The only related items are a community complaint about broad prompt collection in the privacy policy and docs saying prompt caching is automatic with no toggle; neither shows a user-facing retention or deletion control.
